'''Durant''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|General]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Somewhere between [[3665 BBY|3665]] and [[3653 BBY]], Durant fought alongside [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] during the [[Geonosis campaign]] after he became a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Republic Strategic High Command|Republic High Command]].

{{GameDS}}
During the [[Invasion of Taris]] in [[3642 BBY]], Durant was part of the [[War Trust]] in their efforts to defeat the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Together, the War Trust devised a new technology called [[Project Siantide|Siantide]], believing that it would outclass anything the Imperials could come up with. He was later [[Destruction of the War Trust|targeted]] by the Empire, along with the rest of the War Trust, by [[Darth Baras]]' [[Plan Zero]]. Generals [[Minst]] and [[Frelka]] were the first to be hunted down and killed by [[Empire's Wrath|Darth Baras' apprentice]], a cunning and powerful Sith Warrior. When the Warrior infiltrated Durant's base, the General flaunted his prototype blaster powered by Siantide technology. Deciding it was time for a demonstration, Durant ordered his men to attack. However, they underestimated the Sith, who slaughtered them all. Mortally wounded, Durant promised that the Warrior would not defeat General [[Faraire]]. The Warrior mocked him, saying that he had died for nothing and promised to destroy everything he had built. Durant then expired.<ref name="Durant" />
{{Endgame}}
